official_sources.title: GDAL rasterize center and all-touched
official_sources.finding: Default polygon rasterization uses pixel centers; ALL_TOUCHED includes touched pixels; exact center-touch behavior is unspecified.
official_sources.limitation: Exact center-touch cases must fail closed.

official_sources.title: GDAL feature order in overlaps
official_sources.finding: With ALL_TOUCHED and overlapping features, the last processed feature can determine the burned value.
official_sources.limitation: Input order must be canonical and overlaps reviewed.

official_sources.title: GDAL RasterizeOptions configuration
official_sources.finding: RasterizeOptions exposes inverse, allTouched, burn, attribute, bounds, resolution and alignment controls.
official_sources.limitation: Options do not prove geometry validity or CRS correctness.

official_sources.title: Rasterio geometry_mask polarity
official_sources.finding: geometry_mask is False inside shapes by default, supports invert, and switches between center and all-touched support.
official_sources.limitation: Polarity errors can invert accepted support.

official_sources.title: Rasterio rasterize merge and invalid shapes
official_sources.finding: rasterize exposes merge, fill, nodata and skip_invalid; invalid shapes may be skipped with warnings.
official_sources.limitation: Target geometry must fail closed rather than be skipped.

official_sources.title: Rasterio mask crop and padding
official_sources.finding: raster_geometry_mask returns mask, transform and window and supports crop, pad and pad_width.
official_sources.limitation: Padding changes read extent, not accepted support.

official_sources.title: Shapely boundary predicates
official_sources.finding: contains excludes boundary-only points, covers includes them, and touches identifies boundary-only contact.
official_sources.limitation: Pinned versions and valid geometry are required.

official_sources.title: OGC polygon holes
official_sources.finding: A Polygon has one exterior boundary and zero or more interior boundaries, each defining a hole.
official_sources.limitation: The model does not select raster support semantics.
